• Health Monitor tile — check recent Apex job status, scheduled crons, and run errors. After a sandbox refresh, the Schedule Nightly ETL button re-registers the cron with one click.
  • Manage Reportable Objects tile — curate which objects appear in the Report Builder picker. Hide objects users shouldn't report on; add custom objects you want available.
  • Run Migration tile — import standard Salesforce reports into Vital Reports format. Useful when consolidating legacy reports.
  • Granting access — assign the Vital Reports User permission set for standard users; add Vital Reports Admin on top for users who need Builder, Health, and Migration access.
  • Editing this help content — Setup → Custom Metadata Types → CR_Help_Topic → Manage Records. Set each topic's Audience field to All, Admin, or User to control who sees it (Admin = users with the Vital Reports Admin View permission; blank = All).
